verdicts.evidence: lines 1109-1128 wire prev/next/today/refresh/calendar/search; 666, 675, 705, 716, 723, 748 list buttons; 782 note submit; 942-943 open dialogs; 977, 1001, 1054, 1059 dialog buttons. Every control calls the api or navigates as labelled.
lines 499, 518, 757: all jobs come from api.listJobs/getJob; counts at 734-736 and 912 are computed from those arrays; empty and loading states shown instead of sample values (707, 720-723, 924).
lines 961-967 jobSummary (customer, work, address, ref, date, slot) is shown in both the move dialog (1038) and the complete dialog (1094); 1039 restates the kept time slot.

lines 767-769, 773, 778: note draft is written to localStorage on every input and restored when the form is rebuilt, so it survives back, reload and a failed save (797 keeps the textarea value; cleared only on success at 800).

lines 952-953 focus goes to the dialog title, not a button, and the complete form (1057-1098) has no input, so Enter does not complete. Move dialog radios have nothing preselected (987); submit without a choice is rejected (1004).

lines 697-744: the list of the day's jobs in slot order with the search box (307-310) is the first screen; finding a job is typing in place (1123-1127). Complete takes an extra dialog, covered by the destructive exception.

Not in the brief: Directions link to Google Maps (901-905), Call button (908-909), previous/next day and calendar browsing (296-306, 1109-1122), 14-day search (747-764), Next job badge (631), offline bar (286).

Notes card has one filled button, Save note (775); the action bar has one filled button, Complete, beside plain Move day (942-943); each dialog has one filled button and one plain (976-977, 1053-1054); list error has a single Try again (705).

Irreversible complete is the filled btn-ok button in the action bar next to Move day (943) and the filled, first, submit button of the confirm dialog above plain Not yet (1053-1054, 1098). It is the prominently styled action, not secondary.

line 987-992: the radio for the current day is disabled with the text 'Booked for this day now' in it; 938-939 completed jobs drop Move/Complete and say why; other disabling is only during the control's own request (788, 1011, 1064).
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the file; icon buttons use aria-label only (293-304).
All visible strings (lines 286-309, 674-739, 807-810, 860-868, 895-943, 1029-1040, 1088-1096) are about jobs, notes, connection and invoices; none mention implementation, mock data or the request.

Notices sit at their decision: offline bar (286) on saving, 'job keeps its time' in the move dialog (1039), cannot-be-undone warning above the complete button (1095), unsaved-note line (1096), completed-job note in place of the actions (939).

No narration of the screen. Guidance is single short lines at the control: search hint in the no-match state (679), empty detail pane placeholder on desktop (822), 'If you were expecting some, refresh or call the office' (722).

Heading 'Today' with date subtitle (641-642) adds the date, not a restatement; hidden label 'Find a job' vs placeholder listing searchable fields (308-309); 'Add a note' label has no helper text (813). Toast duplication is judged under FB-003.
No greetings, slogans, superlatives or exclamation marks in any string; headings are 'Today', customer name, 'What needs doing', 'Address', 'Phone', 'Notes' (298, 885, 895-912).

line 1054: the dialog's second button is 'Not yet', which is not a verb and does not name its outcome; line 905: button-styled 'Directions' is a noun. Others are fine ('Save note', 'Move to Tue 17 Nov', 'Complete job and email invoice').

Status is rendered as 'Complete'/'Booked' (630, 888), not the enum; job shown by ref 'Job HH-5120' (887), internal id only in the URL; error codes are mapped to sentences (807-810, 1031-1034, 1088-1090).

e.message is never shown. Load: 'Couldn't load today's jobs. The connection dropped. Check your signal and try again.' + Try again (703-705). Saves: 809-810, 1033-1034, 1089-1090 state what did not happen and the next step.

Error strings (674, 703-704, 715, 786, 807-810, 866-867, 916, 928, 1004-1006, 1029-1034, 1088-1090) contain no 'invalid', 'failed', 'oops', capitals or exclamation marks; subject is the connection or the job.
lines 720-723: 'No jobs booked for today', one line of advice and a Refresh button; 739-741 no search match plus 'Search the next 14 days'; 924 'No notes yet.' directly above the add-note form.
Three distinct states: nothing booked with Refresh (720-723); search matched nothing, naming the query, with 'Search the next 14 days' (739-741, 679); load failure with Try again (702-705).

Load failure shows message and Try again in place of the list/job (702-705, 865-868) or keeps stale rows with a warning (714-716). Failed note keeps the text and shows an inline error (797, 809-810); dialogs keep choices (1024-1034, 1086-1090).

Skeletons render immediately on load (494-495, 707, 870-875, 931-934, 669); buttons switch to 'Saving...', 'Moving...', 'Completing...', 'Checking...' (788, 1012, 1065). Worst-case retry chains (459-481) stay under ten seconds.

lines 700-710: with no cached jobs and status loading only the skeleton is rendered; the summary counts (733-736) and empty text (720) need a loaded array. Notes show a skeleton and no count until loaded (912, 930-934).

overflow-wrap:anywhere and min-width:0 on customer, work, address, headings and dialog summary (158-160, 197, 201, 204, 237); list scrolls for many items; h() skips null/undefined children (404-406); empty notes handled (924).
lines 767-778: the unsaved note is stored per job in localStorage on each keystroke and restored when the job is reopened (773); the complete dialog also says the draft is kept (1096).

Move dialog only offers future days as radios (985) and the free date field is labelled 'Or pick a later date' with min set to tomorrow (978, 1041), so the future-date rule is visible and enforced before input.
Note form has one required field (813-814); move form is a single choice of day (1040-1041). No form mixes required and optional fields.
Validation runs only in submit handlers (786, 1004-1006); the input listener only clears an existing error (778, 980-984).
Note error paragraph is rendered directly under the textarea as text in a boxed message (774, 814); move error sits directly under the day and date fields (1042). No toast is used for errors.
line 797 re-enables the textarea without clearing it on failure (cleared only on success, 800); move dialog restores field state and keeps the chosen day (1024-1025).

aria-invalid is never set anywhere. Move dialog errors (1004-1006, 1031-1034) do not move focus and the radios/date input have no aria-describedby to the error (974, 978, 987). Only the note textarea gets focus and describedby (772, 786).

Save note and Move job are enabled from the start (775, 976); submitting empty shows 'Write the note first, then save it.' (786) or 'Choose the day to move this job to.' (1004). Disabled only during the request (788, 1011).

Note: busy flag returns early and the button is disabled with 'Saving...' (784, 787-788). Dialogs: S.dlgBusy guard and disabled buttons (1003, 1008-1012, 1062-1065); uncertain writes are checked by a read before resending (470-481, 792-795).

Buttons have an :active state (87) and change label synchronously on submit (788, 1012, 1065); navigation and refresh render the skeleton or spinning icon at once (494-495, 646-648, 751-753); dialogs open synchronously (949-951).

Saved note appears in the list via applyJob (801, 920); moved job shows new date and a banner (1017-1019, 897); completed job gets the Complete badge and banner (1070-1072, 888). Failures are stated inline (807-810, 1031-1034, 1088-1090).

line 802: 'Note saved' toast while the new note appears in the list and the count rises. Lines 1017-1020 and 1069-1073: the toast repeats the exact text of the banner shown at the top of the job, alongside the changed date or Complete badge.

Errors are inline role=alert blocks that persist until retry or new input (702-705, 714-716, 774-778, 1042, 1051). The only auto-dismissing element is the toast (558-565), which carries success text and no action.

Move runs from a date-picking dialog (969-1045), not a confirmation, and offers no undo (1015-1022). The job can be moved again, but the server rejects today (358), so a move off today cannot be restored. Verdict differed on second pass.

lines 1093-1098: 'Complete this job?' with customer, work, address, ref and date, the warning 'emailed their invoice straight away. This cannot be undone.', buttons 'Complete job and email invoice' / 'Not yet'; focus starts on the title (953), not the confirm.
The only confirmation is on completing a job (1047-1100), which is irreversible and emails an invoice. Save note, refresh and navigation have none; the move dialog is a date form.
No optimistic updates: applyJob is called only after the server responds or a follow-up read confirms (470-481, 798-801, 1015-1019, 1068-1072).
Two modals, both opened by the user's button press (942-943): a single confirm decision (1093-1098) and a short day-choice form (1037-1043). Reading and note writing stay on the page.

Native dialog opened with showModal (951) so focus is trapped and Escape closes (blocked only mid-request, 956); focus moved to the title (952-953); Cancel/Not yet buttons visible (977, 1054); focus returns to trigger or job heading (959).
List pane: day heading, search, then the job list (290-312, 733-738). Detail: customer heading, what needs doing as the first and largest card, then address/phone, then notes (884-936).
No hero or greeting: the header is a small brand label, day heading and search (291-310), followed directly by jobs.

Only summary numbers are 'N to do, M complete' with last-updated time (735-736), search match counts (677, 734) and 'Notes (n)' (912); each tells the engineer what is left today or whether the list is current or filtered.

Search shows 'N of M jobs match "q"' (734) but no clear control is rendered anywhere; the only way to clear is deleting the text in the field (309, 1123-1127). 'Back to today's jobs' (666) leaves the query applied.

All actions are native buttons, links, radios, date inputs and a form (293-309, 621, 775, 942-943, 987, 978); dialogs are native (951). Go-to-date input is focusable though invisible (128), with prev/next buttons as an alternative.

Complete status has a check icon and the word (630, 888); Next job is text (631); errors and warnings are sentences; chosen move day is also written on the button 'Move to ...' (982); selected job is named in the detail heading (885).

Toasts and counts use the pre-existing #live region (320, 552-563), but list and job load errors are new role=alert nodes inserted with their text (702, 714, 865, 915, 927) and loading text is outside any live region (636, 871, 932).
No accordions, disclosure buttons, menus, comboboxes or tabs; the only overlays are native modal dialogs.

Below 900px list and detail are separate full-width views toggled by body.has-job (112-113); rows wrap (158-160); dialog is a bottom sheet with max-height 92dvh and overflow auto (229-232); move days are a two-column grid (242).
No persistent section navigation: the product is one jobs list with a detail view; the only nav element is the back link on the detail bar (842).
The hash holds only date and job id (568-572). The search query and the 14-day search mode live only in S.query and S.wide (447-448, 1123-1127) and are lost on reload or when sharing the link.

Hash routing (609, 1143): Back from a job returns to the list, restores scroll and focuses the row (583, 600-603); the query stays in memory; open dialogs are closed on route change and are not in history (581).
Job-not-found has 'Back to jobs' (863); load errors have Try again (705, 868) and the detail bar keeps the Jobs back link (837-842); empty day has Refresh and day navigation (723, 296-306).
line 318: native <dialog id=dlg aria-labelledby=dlgTitle>, opened with showModal (951); both dialog bodies supply an h2 with id dlgTitle (1037, 1093).
No stepped flows; note, move and complete are each a single form or decision.
min-height 48px on .btn (81), 44px on .btn-small (92) and .totoday (138), 48x48 icon buttons (96), 48px search field (132), 72px job rows (151), 48px back link (193), 56px day options (246).

Sticky header is about 168px (220px with 'Back to today') of 667 (116-141); the action bar is a sticky in-flow flex child so content ends above it (188, 218-222); the toast is fixed but leaves after 5s (257-262, 564).
